requirements.text: CODEX.sol is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol, solFallback is gpt-6-sol, solLegacy is gpt-5.6-sol; familyOf recognizes any major/minor GPT family; escalation tries all available Sols in order, retains the first target's thinking level and stops at high; preserve SPEC-0009 tiers/models tests.
Update tests/bounds-split.test.ts to derive escalation targets from CODEX rather than hard-coded Sol literals, preserving behaviour and baseline tests.
machina default is bare gpt-6.1-sol, enabled Sol/Luna/Astra and thinking levels and routing tiers match §6.1, leaving pipeline thinking intact.
agent/models.json openai-codex modelOverrides adds gpt-6.1-sol contextWindow 272000 and promptCache short/long 1800 with no cost override.
Pin pi at 0.99.1: deps.txt stays pinned, install.sh default and README references change; after V4 update version comments in quota-gate.ts and settings-keys.ts; keep portable example host portable.
Delete SPEC-0009's superseded host-config.test.ts; append a supersession line to SPEC-0009 §11; index entries 0011 and 0014 become implemented by pi and pi pipeline respectively.
testEnv(base) returns a copy without PI_BUILD_PIPELINE, PI_BUILD_SUBAGENT_ROLE, PI_BUILD_TELEMETRY_DB; every test command in runner, entrypoint and doctor uses clean environment.
costByRole(rows) sums planner/editor/integration/other and total including null-cost/unknown-role rows correctly.
Run record reads inference_calls subagent_role,cost_usd across every database (planner, repair, editor, integration) and reports all five role totals.
doctor.sh tests execute with the three pipeline variables removed, including when doctor itself inherits PI_BUILD_PIPELINE=1.

childPiArgs constructs JSON-mode pi invocation (--mode json first, -p prompt last), continuation/session/model/thinking/approve preserved; implementArgs builds spec --progress json plus ordered optional flags.

lib/progress.ts defines ProgressEvent protocol and childEventToProgress, parseProgressLine, initialProgress, reduceProgress, renderProgress, progressSummary, finalText as fixed by progress.test.ts; malformed lines ignored; cost, notices, task state and branch summary retained.

Runner/entrypoint progress JSON stdout is exclusively valid events; stage ordering, task starts/ends, per-child activity/usage, notices and done; streamed child pi.log and finalText; terminal output preserved without flag; SIGTERM stops current child, retains worktree/run for resume and emits failed done, exit 130; quota/preflight failures retained.

extensions/pipeline.ts registers implement_spec with specified parameters/description/rendering; starts repository-root runner in testEnv, streams parsed progress through onUpdate, handles abort SIGTERM, failed handoff, exit 75 instructions and exit 2 reasons.
agent/EXTENSIONS.md documents pipeline tool ownership and no event subscriptions; README Developing with pi documents chat tool and retained terminal route.

Step 0 verifies grounding and catalog/tools, records expected vs actual; execute V1–V11 and final integrated acceptance with V10 scratch worktree/cleanup, baseline, cost, stage/path evidence, protected diff and deviations in run record; no protected test edits beyond SPEC-0009 supersession.

tasks.brief: Stage 1. Read SPEC-0015 §6.1 and §8, lib/tiers.ts and this spec's tiers.test.ts and SPEC-0009 tiers.test.ts. Edit only lib/tiers.ts. Resolve the §6.1 fallback-thinking ambiguity against the protected tiers.test.ts (which expects high when Luna's medium target is unavailable), document the deviation in the run record; implement CODEX sol/solFallback/solLegacy and all-version family detection; preserve retryAllowed, Astra stop, stop at high and old tests. Do not edit tests, router, other files or package patches.

Stage 1. Edit only settings/hosts/machina.json. Read SPEC-0015 §6.1, current machina.json and docs/specs/SPEC-0015-move-to-gpt-6-1-sol-and-run-the-pipeline-from-chat.tests/host-config.test.ts. Set defaultModel to bare 'gpt-6.1-sol'; enabledModels exactly ['openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol','openai-codex/gpt-6-luna','openai-codex/gpt-6-astra']; modelThinkingLevels keyed by those three at medium, medium, high; routing.tiers scout/explain Luna and work/escalate 6.1 Sol. Preserve defaultProvider, all other keys, routing.enabled=false, pipeline plannerThinking=high and editorThinking=medium. Do not edit tests, plan, example.json, packages or other files.

Stage 1. Edit only agent/models.json. Read SPEC-0015 §6.1, current overrides and this spec's host-config.test.ts. Under providers.openai-codex.modelOverrides add gpt-6.1-sol with contextWindow 272000 and promptCache {short:1800,long:1800}; do not add cost or change any existing model, other provider, tests, plan or any other file.

Stage 1. Edit only tests/bounds-split.test.ts. Read §6.1, existing bounds test and CODEX in lib/tiers.ts. Replace literal Sol escalation assertions with CODEX-derived targets while preserving all existing assertions and behavioural coverage. This is a repository test, not a protected spec test. Do not edit any spec .tests/ or implementation files.

Stage 1. Edit only install.sh. Read §6.1 and current PI_VERSION declaration; change only its default from 0.87.1 to 0.99.1 (keep ${PI_VERSION:-...} override semantics and every other command). Do not edit deps.txt, README, tests, plan, router package or other files.

Stage 1. Edit only README.md. Read SPEC-0015 §6.1 and current install instructions. Replace every 0.87.1 with 0.99.1; preserve other content for the stage-3 documentation task. Do not touch other paths, protected tests or change route semantics.

Stage 1. Delete ONLY SPEC-0009's host-config.test.ts as explicitly permitted by SPEC-0015 §6.1. Do not edit its other protected tests or any other file. This spec's host-config.test.ts is the replacement.

Stage 1. Append one line to §11 Landing in this file saying its host-config.test.ts is superseded by SPEC-0015's host-config.test.ts. Read both specs and do not edit sections other than §11, other files or protected tests.

Stage 2 (loose-ends index write; placed after Stage 1). Edit only docs/specs/index.md. Read SPEC-0015 §6.2 and the two exact rows. In row 0011 set Status 'implemented' and Implemented by 'pi'; in row 0014 set Status 'implemented' and Implemented by 'pi pipeline'. Preserve all other cells and rows including 0015; no other files, tests or plan edits.

Stage 2. Edit only lib/pipeline.ts. Read SPEC-0015 §6.2, this spec's pipeline-hygiene.test.ts, current pipeline.ts and lib/telemetry.ts row fields. Add export testEnv(base: Record<string,string|undefined>): Record<string,string|undefined> returning a NEW shallow copy of base without PI_BUILD_PIPELINE, PI_BUILD_SUBAGENT_ROLE, PI_BUILD_TELEMETRY_DB; never mutate base. Add export costByRole(rows: {role:string|null; cost:number|null}[]): {planner:number;editor:number;integration:number;other:number;total:number}; null/invalid cost counts zero, unknown/null role goes to other. Preserve childEnv, pipelineRunRoot, pipelineTelemetryDbs, preflight and testCommands untouched. No other files, tests or plan edits.

Stage 2. Edit only doctor.sh. Read SPEC-0015 §6.2/§8 and all test invocations in doctor.sh. Strip PI_BUILD_PIPELINE, PI_BUILD_SUBAGENT_ROLE and PI_BUILD_TELEMETRY_DB from the environment of every test invocation (Node and uv), without changing non-test preflight or credential checks. Keep --offline and --project behaviour. No other paths or tests.

Stage 3. Edit only lib/pipeline.ts after T10. Read SPEC-0015 §6.3, pipeline-hygiene.test.ts, bin/pi-implement's existing planner args and scripts/run-plan.mjs piArgs. Export childPiArgs(input:{model:string;thinking:string;prompt:string;sessionDir:string;continuing?:boolean}):string[] with ['--mode','json'] first, then --model <model> --thinking <thinking> --session-dir <sessionDir>, optional --continue when continuing, --approve and ['-p',prompt] last. Export implementArgs(input:{spec:string;planOnly?:boolean;resume?:boolean}):string[] as [spec,'--progress','json', optional '--plan-only', optional '--resume'] in that order. Do not modify any existing function, tests, plan, call site or other file.

Stage 3. New file only lib/progress.ts. Read §6.0/§6.3/§7, entire protected progress.test.ts and pi 0.99.1 JSON event shapes from spec prior art. Define/export ProgressEvent union and childEventToProgress(role,taskId,event), parseProgressLine(line), initialProgress(spec), reduceProgress(state,event), renderProgress(state,expanded), progressSummary(state), finalText(log). Strictly ignore malformed/unknown events, clip tool targets to 80 characters, count cost by role using usage events (not task_end duplicate cost), retain tasks/notices/recent actions, final branch/run record/cost, support seven protected tests; protocol used by runner/tool. Do not edit tests, runner, extension, package patches or other files.

Stage 3. Edit only scripts/run-plan.mjs. Read §6.3, existing spawn/continuation/grade/hold paths, pipeline.ts helpers and progress.ts protocol. Replace piArgs with childPiArgs. Spawn children JSON-mode, stream stdout JSONL verbatim into pi.log as received and forward childEventToProgress activity/usage/notice in progress mode; keep stderr off stdout; use finalText(log) instead of reading pi.log as prose for quality. Apply testEnv(process.env) to every runTests test command, including before/after task and final grade. Emit tasks/integration stages, per-task start/end with model/results/rounds/cost, gate/hold/escalation/warning notices through the shared protocol; preserve traditional terminal output without --progress and all grading, protected-file, continuation and telemetry behaviour. Ensure SIGTERM terminates current child and leaves resumable work. Do not edit bin, helper libraries, tests or any other path.

Stage 3. Edit only bin/pi-implement. Read §6.0–§6.3, runner's progress mode, pipeline.ts costByRole/childPiArgs/testEnv, progress.ts protocol, planner and handoff code. Add --progress json while preserving unflagged/dry-run output; stdout only JSON progress events, other text stderr, emit preflight/plan/gate/grade/handoff/done (and forward runner events in order), stream planner and runner children JSON mode rather than spawnSync text; log JSONL pi.log as it arrives; finalText for prose. On SIGTERM terminate current child, keep worktree/run directory for --resume, emit failed done then exit 130. Run EVERY test command with testEnv. Query inference_calls subagent_role,cost_usd in all run DBs (including repair, editor, integration) and write planner/editor/integration/other/total to run record. Preserve quota 75/preflight 2, branch-only handoff and no-progress terminal output. Resolve seams/deviations in run record; no other files/tests.

Stage 3. Add only extensions/pipeline.ts. Read §3, §6.3, protected V9 requirement, pi 0.99.1 subagent example and existing extensions/memory-gate.ts tool registration. Register implement_spec with exact spec description and Typebox parameters spec required, planOnly/resume optional. Locate repo root for ctx.cwd, spawn <root>/bin/pi-implement using implementArgs in testEnv(process.env), stdout line-by-line parseProgressLine/reduceProgress and onUpdate({content:[{type:'text',text:progressSummary(state)}],details:state}); renderCall as implement_spec <spec>, renderResult with renderProgress(details,expanded). Handle SIGTERM on abort, failures/exit 75 quota resume instruction and exit 2 preflight reasons; isError unless handed off. No event subscriptions, no other file, no changes to pi-smart-router or tests. Integration must write fake runner test in tests/ for V9 separately during final integration.

Stage 3. Edit only agent/EXTENSIONS.md; read §6.3 and existing extension ownership table. State extensions/pipeline.ts owns implement_spec and subscribes to no events. Preserve all other entries. Do not modify extensions or tests.

Stage 3. Edit only README.md, after the stage-1 version update. Read SPEC-0015 §6.3 and Developing with pi. Explain asking pi to implement a spec runs a streaming tool call in chat, and bin/pi-implement remains available in terminal; preserve version changes. Do not edit other files or protected tests.

Stage 3. Add only tests/pipeline-tool.test.ts for V9. Read SPEC-0015 §8, extensions/pipeline.ts and pi extension tool shape. Register extension with fake pi and fake runner script/child to show onUpdate streaming before completion, final summary/branch, isError on failure, exit 75 quota resume message, exit 2 preflight reasons, and abort SIGTERM terminating child. Use temp fixtures, no provider calls, clean up. Do not edit protected .tests/, extension code or any other file.

Stage 3 final documentation after V4 has actually passed. Edit only the verified-version COMMENT in extensions/quota-gate.ts from 0.87.1 to 0.99.1; no runtime changes. Read §6.1 V4; do not edit quota logic or any other path. Record V4 result in run record.

Stage 3 final documentation after V4 has actually passed. Edit only the version HEADER in lib/settings-keys.ts to 0.99.1; no code changes. Read §6.1 V4 and current header. Do not edit keys, tests or other files.

Stage 3 final record only. Read SPEC-0015 §4, §8–§10 and actual measured outputs. Record start revision and step-0 expected/actual including pi catalog and built-in tool defaults; each V1–V11 command/result or NOT RUN, baseline and repairs, final integrated acceptance, V10 scratch worktree/branch cleanup, O→evidence, §7 paths, protected diff, protocol and tool callers, deviations. Run V4 before version comments; never mark unrun checks passed. This is a run-record task, not permission to change implementation, tests or spec.
